subject.title: Sub-agent timeout recovery creates duplicate API posts (idempotency gap)

question: Should OpenClaw provide a core logical-action idempotency/replay contract for sub-agent side effects, or keep idempotency responsibility on individual tools, plugins, and external APIs?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent boundary affects Gateway RPC semantics, plugin SDK contracts, subagent recovery, and third-party side-effect ownership, so automation should not choose it alone.

options.title: Define a core-owned logical action contract
options.body: Add a narrow claim/commit/replay boundary for OpenClaw-owned Gateway/tool/plugin side effects and require tests for lost-ack retries returning the original result or an already-committed status.

options.title: Keep per-surface idempotency only
options.body: Document that subagents and plugins must provide logical idempotency keys to external systems, while core continues to dedupe only supported Gateway methods by supplied key.

options.title: Move the pattern to ClawHub guidance
options.body: Treat the broader external-API coordination pattern as a skill/plugin bundle and keep this core issue open only for missing extension APIs.

recommendation.title: Define a core-owned logical action contract
recommendation.body: Add a narrow claim/commit/replay boundary for OpenClaw-owned Gateway/tool/plugin side effects and require tests for lost-ack retries returning the original result or an already-committed status.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available subagent history signal and is already linked in the issue timeline for the remaining product boundary decision.
